verdict.rationale: Bento documents real bulk endpoints: POST /batch/subscribers bulk-creates or updates 1–1000 subscribers per request without triggering automations, and POST /batch/events tracks activity and updates fields in batch. The CLI supports CSV imports, and Bento Skills gives agents safety guidance for bulk subscriber imports. Filtered search makes it possible to target many records at once. Missing for 10: explicit bulk delete, bulk tag, or bulk field-edit operations across existing items; evidence that the MCP server itself performs bulk actions; independent or hands-on corroboration of batch behavior at scale.
